title: Ernst Steinitz: Modern LaTeX Source Transcriptions and English Translation Working Packets
description:
Dedicated Ernst Steinitz author record split from the mixed additional-author staging shelf. This record collects current modern-LaTeX German source transcriptions, English translation working drafts, source witnesses, and audit/provenance packets for substantial Steinitz work.

Current upload scope. Included packages cover: (1) Algebraische Theorie der Koerper sections 1-24 complete in German and English working TeX/PDF; (2) the core corpus packet completing the 1913 Bedingt konvergente Reihen und konvexe Systeme I; (3) a strict/manual package for the 1894 dissertation, the 1897 configuration paper, and the 1906 Euler polyhedron-relations paper; (4) the 1914 Bedingt konvergente Reihen und konvexe Systeme II complete through pp.1-40; and (5) Steinitz_44_bedingtIII_p001-013_shortpaths.zip, the first Bedingt III tranche, covering pp.1-13 with German/English TeX/PDF, source scans, render checks, page checklist, formula ledger, progress log, and math sanity note.

Quality level. These are package-audited working editions and source-witnessed translation drafts, not final scholarly critical editions. The strict/manual packages identify their own page-by-page source checks. OCR or extracted text is non-authoritative and should be treated only as a locator/witness layer; package READMEs, progress ledgers, source scans, and render/audit files define the promoted scope.

Known gaps. The current status files still mark the 1908 Beitraege zur Analysis Situs source as unresolved. Bedingt III is started through pp.1-13 only; the remainder of the 1916 paper remains open. The 1916/1922 polyhedron-space-division work and the 1927/1928 isoperimetric papers are source-present but not completed in this public package set.

Corrections, exact source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, and translation improvements can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Dedicated Steinitz author-level split from the additional-author cluster. Latest update adds Steinitz_44_bedingtIII_p001-013_shortpaths.zip, starting 1916 Bedingt III through pp.1-13 with source witnesses and ledgers. Treat all files as working/source-witnessed drafts rather than final critical editions.
